title: AutoTuneBench: Trustworthy Measurement for Agent Auto-Tuning of LLM Serving Engines
abstract: arXiv:2609.18123v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model agents tune GPU kernels and serving engines through a closed loop of propose, measure, and keep, but the measurements behind this loop are not trustworthy. We characterize four failure modes from a four-day pilot corpus of 619 model calls: strawman baselines manufacture speedups, absolute times do not transfer across machines, saturated tasks nullify comparisons, and infrastructure defects impersonate science. We present AutoTuneBench, a benchmark and measurement protocol that makes trust architectural. The protocol is frozen as code with test-enforced provenance; a database-level validator rejects out-of-protocol results; anti-cheat checks run outside the agent's modification surface; comparisons follow pre-registered readouts; and measurements anchor to externally published results, grounded in paired-seed statistics with a 5\% cross-run coefficient-of-variation cap. translated_title: AutoTuneBench：面向大语言模型服务引擎智能体自动调优的可信测量
translated_abstract: 大语言模型智能体通过“提出、测量、保留”的闭环来调优GPU内核和服务引擎，但这一闭环背后的测量并不可信。我们从为期四天、包含619次模型调用的试点语料库中刻画了四种失败模式：稻草人基线制造出虚假加速、绝对时间无法在不同机器间迁移、饱和任务使比较失效、基础设施缺陷伪装成科学成果。我们提出AutoTuneBench，一个将可信性内建于架构的基准与测量协议。该协议以代码形式冻结并带有测试强制执行的溯源；数据库级验证器会拒绝协议外的结果；反作弊检查在智能体可修改表面之外运行；比较遵循预先注册的读数；测量锚定于外部发布的结果，并基于配对种子统计，跨运行变异系数上限为5%。诚实的测量改写了结论：我们的b
tldr: 提出AutoTuneBench基准与测量协议，通过冻结协议代码、数据库级验证、反作弊检查、预注册比较及外部结果锚定等架构化机制，解决智能体自动调优LLM服务引擎中测量结果不可信的四种失败模式。
en_tdlr: AutoTuneBench introduces a benchmark and measurement protocol that makes agent auto-tuning of LLM serving engines trustworthy by architecturally embedding frozen code-based protocols, database-level validation, external anti-cheat checks, pre-registered comparisons, and anchoring to published results.
